claim: The frozen record warning gives strictly greater uninterrupted intended-task success than nine evenly spaced repair calls.
endpoint: All eighteen assessments at generations 15-32 satisfy both ports under both cues, each strict aligned mean >0.25.
inference_unit: Block; all policies and sixteen cases paired within block; four history strata.
enrollment: Every acquired record after generation 14, irrespective of success; retain every branch after failure.
unresolved_if: Positive point estimate with descriptive paired stratified block-bootstrap 95% interval including zero.
directional_support_if: Positive primary estimate and positive lower descriptive interval; limited to this supplied apparatus and schedule. No practical effect threshold or general law established.
sample_rationale: One 16-block feasibility cohort as in the previous source programme, with four blocks per history; no power claim for small improvements and no optional stopping.
budget_rationale: Nine is half the eighteen-call recurring correction budget, selected as a simple midpoint before feature extraction; no search over budgets.
limitations: Risk prediction need not rank causal repair benefit.
Nine-call periodic policy may already approach ceiling.
Equal calls do not match total CPU or added weights.
Ordinary graph correction remains a strong explanation.
Teaching/reset still matched; apparatus remains supplied.
